reason: Provides browser-based previews for DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files in better-sidebar by registering three Office document viewers with optional enablement controls and download fallback.

summaries.zh: 为 better-sidebar 注册 DOCX、XLSX 和 PPTX 文件预览器，在浏览器中提供 Office 文档预览。
summaries.en: Adds browser-based DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX previews to better-sidebar through three registered Office file viewers.

capabilities: Registers file viewers for DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX files
Renders Office documents in the browser
Provides viewer enablement controls and download fallback on rendering failure
